title: IELTS Speaking Mock Test 1 — Childhood & Memories
part1: Where did you grow up?
Did you enjoy your childhood? Why?
What games did you play as a child?
Do you keep in touch with friends from your childhood?
How is your hometown different now compared to when you were young?

part2.topic: Describe a memorable experience from your childhood.
bullets: and explain how it has influenced who you are today

part3: How important is childhood for a person's development?
Do you think children today have a better or worse childhood than previous generations?
How has technology changed the way children spend their free time?
What role should parents play in shaping their children's experiences?
Should schools teach children about their cultural heritage? Why or why not?

title: IELTS Speaking Mock Test 2 — Technology & Daily Life
part1: How often do you use a smartphone in a typical day?
What apps do you use most frequently?
Do you prefer reading physical books or e-books?
Has technology made your daily life easier or more complicated?
Do you think people spend too much time on social media?

part2.topic: Describe a piece of technology that has changed your life.
bullets: when you first started using it
how you use it in your daily life
and explain why it has been so important to you

part3: How has the internet transformed the way people communicate?
Do you think artificial intelligence will replace human jobs in the future?
What are the main dangers of excessive technology use for young people?
Should governments regulate social media platforms? Why or why not?
How can technology help address global environmental problems?

title: IELTS Speaking Mock Test 3 — Travel & Places
part1: Do you enjoy travelling? Why or why not?
What was the last place you visited?
Do you prefer travelling alone or with others?
What kind of accommodation do you prefer when you travel?
Is there a place you have always wanted to visit?

part2.topic: Describe a country or city you would like to visit in the future.
bullets: why you want to visit it
what you would do or see there
and explain why you have not been there yet

part3: How has international travel changed people's understanding of other cultures?
Do you think tourism has more positive or negative effects on local communities?
Should governments invest more in public transport to encourage domestic tourism?
How has online booking changed the travel industry?
What responsibilities do tourists have when visiting other countries?

title: IELTS Speaking Mock Test 4 — Work & Career
part1: Do you work or are you a student?
What kind of work would you like to do in the future?
Do you prefer working indoors or outdoors? Why?
Is it important to you to have a job you enjoy?
How many hours a week do you think is a reasonable amount to work?

part2.topic: Describe a job you think you would be good at.
bullets: what skills or qualities it requires
why you think you would be good at it
and explain whether you would enjoy doing this job every day

part3: How important is job satisfaction compared to a high salary?
Do you think the traditional 9-to-5 working day is still relevant today?
How has remote working affected people's work-life balance?
Should companies prioritise hiring local workers over foreign workers? Why?
What skills do you think will be most valued in the workplace in 20 years?

title: IELTS Speaking Mock Test 5 — Health & Lifestyle
part1: Do you exercise regularly? What do you do?
How important is healthy eating to you?
Do you get enough sleep? Why or why not?
Have you ever tried a new sport or physical activity?
What do you do to relax after a stressful day?

part2.topic: Describe a healthy habit you have developed.
bullets: when and why you started it
how it has affected your life
and explain whether you would recommend it to others

part3: Why do you think many people find it difficult to maintain a healthy lifestyle?
Should governments do more to encourage healthy eating? If so, how?
How has modern life made it harder for people to be physically active?
Do you think health education in schools is effective?
Should employers be responsible for the health and wellbeing of their employees?

title: IELTS Speaking Mock Test 6 — Education & Learning
part1: What subject did you enjoy most at school? Why?
How do you prefer to learn new things — by reading, watching, or doing?
Do you think the education system in your country is good?
Did you have a favourite teacher? What made them special?
Do you still study or learn new things in your spare time?

part2.topic: Describe a course or class you have taken that you found particularly useful.
bullets: where and when you took it
and explain why it has been useful in your life

part3: How important is university education in today's society?
Do you think traditional classroom learning will eventually be replaced by online learning?
Should education be free for everyone? What are the advantages and disadvantages?
How can countries improve the quality of their education systems?
Do you think intelligence is more important than hard work for academic success?

title: IELTS Speaking Mock Test 7 — Environment & Nature
part1: How often do you spend time in nature?
Do you think people in your city care about the environment?
Do you try to reduce the amount of waste you produce?
Have you ever participated in any environmental activity?
What is your favourite type of natural environment — mountains, forest, beach, or something else?

part2.topic: Describe a natural place you have visited and found beautiful.
bullets: when and how you got there
what made it special or beautiful
and explain how you felt while you were there

part3: How serious is the problem of climate change in your country?
What can individuals do to help protect the environment in everyday life?
Do you think businesses have enough responsibility for protecting the environment?
Should governments impose heavy taxes on companies that pollute? Why?
How can technology help solve environmental problems?

title: IELTS Speaking Mock Test 8 — Arts & Culture
part1: Do you enjoy visiting museums or art galleries?
What type of music do you like to listen to?
Have you ever been to a concert or live performance?
Do you have any creative hobbies, such as painting, writing, or playing music?
Is there a film or book that has had a strong impact on you?

part2.topic: Describe a work of art, a book, or a film that impressed you greatly.
bullets: what it was about or what it depicted
and explain why it left such a strong impression on you

part3: How important are the arts in a society?
Do you think governments should fund the arts? Why or why not?
How has the internet changed the way people consume and create art?
Is it important for children to learn about traditional arts and culture?
Do you think popular culture has a positive or negative influence on society?

title: IELTS Speaking Mock Test 9 — Food & Traditions
part1: What is your favourite food? Why do you like it?
Do you enjoy cooking? What do you like to cook?
How often do you eat out at restaurants?
Is food an important part of celebrations in your culture?
Have you ever tried food from another country that you really enjoyed?

part2.topic: Describe a traditional dish from your country or culture.
bullets: what the dish is and what it is made of
on what occasions it is typically eaten
and explain why it is important or special to you

part3: How important is food to cultural identity?
Do you think globalisation has had a positive or negative effect on traditional cuisines?
Should schools teach children about nutrition and healthy eating habits?
How has the fast food industry changed people's eating habits?
Do you think people today are more or less adventurous about trying new foods than in the past?

title: IELTS Speaking Mock Test 10 — Friendship & Relationships
part1: How do you usually make new friends?
Do you prefer having a few close friends or many acquaintances?
How do you stay in touch with friends who live far away?
Have you ever made a friend through the internet or social media?
What do you value most in a friendship?

part2.topic: Describe a friend who has had a positive influence on your life.
bullets: in what ways they have influenced you
and explain why you value this friendship so much

part3: How have social media platforms changed the nature of friendship?
Do you think it is harder to make genuine friends as an adult compared to when you were a child?
How important is it to have friends from different cultural backgrounds?
Can people who have never met in person be true friends? Why or why not?
What are the qualities that make someone a good friend?

Would you like to stay there in the future?

part2.topic: Describe a public place in your town that you enjoy visiting

part3: Why are public spaces important in cities?

How might public spaces change in future?

part1: What are you studying at present?

part2.topic: Describe a skill you learned from another person

part3: Which skills are best learned from other people?

Why do adults stop learning new skills?
How can schools encourage independent learning?

part1: What type of work do you do?
What is the most challenging part?
Do you work better in the morning or afternoon?
Would you like to change careers?

part2.topic: Describe a journey that took longer than expected

part3: Why do transport delays cause stress?
Should cities discourage private cars?

part1: What food do you eat regularly?
Do you enjoy cooking?

Have your eating habits changed?
Do you visit local markets?

part2.topic: Describe a meal you enjoyed with other people

part3: Why are shared meals important?
How have family meals changed?
Should schools teach cooking?
Why do people eat restaurant food?
How does food express culture?

title: Speaking Practice Test 05
part1: What weather do you enjoy most?
Does weather affect your plans?
What is the hottest season in your area?
Would you like to live in a different climate?
What outdoor activities are common?

part2.topic: Describe a time when weather changed your plans

part3: How should cities prepare for extreme weather?

Should employers adapt to severe weather?
Why do people ignore forecasts?

title: Speaking Practice Test 06
part1: How often do you meet friends?
What do you usually do together?
Is it easy to make friends in your area?
Have your friendships changed over time?
How often do you send messages?

part2.topic: Describe a friend who has influenced you

part3: Why do some friendships last a long time?
Has technology improved friendship?
Is it harder for adults to make friends?
Should friends always give honest advice?
How do friendships affect wellbeing?

title: Speaking Practice Test 07
part1: What music do you listen to?
When do you usually listen?
Did you learn an instrument?
Is live music popular in your town?
What events take place locally?

part2.topic: Describe a live event you attended

part3: Why do communities hold public events?
Should governments fund cultural events?
How do events affect local businesses?
Are large events environmentally responsible?
Why do people value live performance?

title: Speaking Practice Test 08
part1: How often do you shop online?
What do you prefer buying in a shop?
Have your shopping habits changed?
Do you compare prices?
Are clothes important to you?

part2.topic: Describe something useful you bought after careful research

part3: Why do consumers research expensive products?
How reliable are online reviews?
Should advertising be more tightly regulated?
Why do people replace products quickly?

title: Speaking Practice Test 09
part1: What exercise do you do?
Where do people exercise locally?
Did you play sport at school?
What makes exercise difficult?
Where do you get health information?

part2.topic: Describe an activity that helps you stay healthy

part3: Who is responsible for public health?
How can workplaces support healthy behaviour?
Why is prevention difficult to fund?
Should unhealthy products cost more?
How can cities encourage exercise?

title: Speaking Practice Test 10
part1: Which device do you use most?
What task does technology make easier?
Is there technology you avoid?
How has technology changed your studies or work?
How often do you take photographs?

part2.topic: Describe a piece of technology you found difficult at first
bullets: how you learned to use it

part3: Why do people resist new technology?
Should digital skills be compulsory at school?
How can technology exclude some groups?
Who should protect personal data?
Will automation improve most jobs?

title: Speaking Practice Test 11
part1: Do you enjoy long journeys?

Do you plan trips carefully?

part2.topic: Describe a place you would like to visit for a short holiday

part3: What makes a destination attractive?
How can tourism benefit residents?
Should visitor numbers be limited?

title: Speaking Practice Test 12
part1: Do you keep plants at home?

part2.topic: Describe a garden or natural area you remember

part3: Why do cities need natural areas?
Should private land contribute to biodiversity?
How can children learn about nature?

title: Speaking Practice Test 13
part1: Which languages do you speak?
When do you use English?
What is difficult about learning a language?
Would you like to learn another language?
Does your name have a meaning?

part2.topic: Describe a useful conversation you had in another language

part3: Why do some languages become less widely spoken?
Should governments protect minority languages?
How does language influence identity?

What makes language teaching effective?

part1: How often do you follow the news?

part2.topic: Describe a news story that interested you

part3: How should people judge whether news is reliable?

part1: What celebrations are important to you?

part2.topic: Describe a celebration you helped organise

part3: Why do celebrations change over time?
Do commercial influences harm celebrations?
Should workplaces recognise diverse festivals?
